title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.

thread.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! • Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: The dominant reaction is enthusiastic approval, with many commenters calling the episode exceptionally enjoyable and praising its romantic tension.
Several commenters found the central relationship charming, especially the mutual yearning, awkwardness, and gradual emotional development.
The episode’s comedic and sensual presentation generated strong amusement and excitement.
Multiple commenters praised the animation and visual direction, particularly the expressive character acting and a standout intimate sequence.
Some viewers felt the romance was deliberately frustrating because the characters continue misunderstanding each other, though they generally viewed that tension as rewarding slow-burn drama.
A notable minority questioned the handling of consent and the ethically troubling premise, especially around the potion’s influence.
A few commenters found the potion’s rules confusing or underwhelming and thought some developments could have been executed more clearly.
